title: The Shepherd Finds His Sheep
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler of warm hugs and warm hearts, and tonight the Lord Himself goes out into the dark field after the one sheep that feels left out, which is exactly the tenderness Willow shows the boy alone at the edge of the playground.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because going after someone who feels left out is pure tenderness. In Willow’s world today: a boy sat by himself at the edge of the playground with his hood pulled up. Willow left the swings and sat down beside him. After a while she gave him half of her crackers. Just like the Shepherd going to find His lost sheep, Willow learned that Heavenly Father wants nobody left alone.
